notes: State expectations come from games/orbit-draft/tests/model.py (upstream rules 3.0.1). The only emulator-derived input is origin, upstream's entropy(): each new game samples the title-song position, logged at 0x4720 (count, values) and fed to the model; every other byte is the model's prediction, read from the kept state at 0x4740. The moves come from a greedy two-move search on the model; synthetic-second-clear continues into the next round with the board and score kept, and synthetic-lose fills the board without spins. Key gaps leave 60000 cycles per animation frame. synthetic-title and synthetic-first-clear require a PCM peak of 21000.
